source_evidence.fact: The relocated C++ journey uses Heap allocator injection, BufferPool reuse, mapping and LifetimePlan through the public Mem facade.
The public BufferView and ConstBufferView preserve resource identity, native handle, offset and size without owning storage.
FixedArena is a caller-buffer, single-owner, no-fallback bump allocator with explicit bulk reset.
BufferPool implements bounded thread-safe reuse, RAII leases and exact resource statistics over an open MemoryResource.

journeys.consumer: an isolated subsystem heap injected through a runtime-erased allocator
journeys.normal_shape: 64 mixed 24 B to 3 KiB aligned successful allocations, endpoint touches and reverse frees on one owner thread
journeys.candidate: Heap::allocator() over the locked vendored mimalloc heap
journeys.peer: std::pmr::memory_resource runtime erasure over a distinct heap from the identical vendored mimalloc build
journeys.excluded: heap construction, final destruction, OOM injection and bulk clear
journeys.claim_boundary: runtime-erased successful heap lifecycle only; not every mimalloc mode or concurrent allocation claim

journeys.consumer: caller-owned fixed scratch storage reset once per phase
journeys.normal_shape: 64 mixed aligned allocations and endpoint touches in a 128 KiB external buffer followed by one epoch reset
journeys.peer: std::pmr::monotonic_buffer_resource rebuilt in place because standard release does not rewind its initial caller buffer
journeys.excluded: backing allocation, fallback, individual free and owner destruction outside the reset operation
journeys.claim_boundary: single-owner external-buffer epochs only; not growable Arena retention

journeys.consumer: Compute-shaped non-zero BufferView ranges over one warm resource allocation
journeys.normal_shape: 64 validated 3-4 KiB non-overlapping subviews of a 256 KiB host buffer, each synchronously filled
journeys.candidate: public subview Result followed by BufferView::fill
journeys.peer: fused lower-bound helper with the same validity/range/overflow Status checks and the same single MemoryResource fill dispatch
journeys.excluded: Buffer allocation, backend queueing, staging, Event and Stream
journeys.claim_boundary: public view abstraction overhead for a normal range operation; the lower bound is not an external provider SOTA claim

journeys.consumer: a warmed thread-safe transient storage owner returning native-handle views and exact lifecycle statistics
journeys.normal_shape: 64 held 256 B to 4 KiB blocks, native-handle observation and reverse RAII return with the working set retained
journeys.candidate: BufferPool over system_resource with 64-buffer/byte retention bounds, no growth slack and exact stats
journeys.peer: current oneTBB memory_pool plus a charged zero-allocation Result/RAII/view/stats adapter over scalable_allocator
journeys.excluded: pool construction, first working-set allocation, final trim/destruction and provider OOM injection
journeys.claim_boundary: this steady-state variable-size lifecycle; provider allocation count and retained backing are algorithm results, not universal GPU allocation claims
